source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: README.md is the curated list itself; src/main.rs checks its links and writes its results to results/. The cleanup, hacktoberfest and pr_tidyup binaries are used for maintenance, and the lint files check the format.
